question_text: How many Canadian party leaders will resign after the 2025 election?
resolution_criteria:
If 5 Canadian political party leaders announce their intent to resign their positions as party leader within a week of the election being called in 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
This specifically and exclusively includes the leaders of the Liberal Party, Conservative Party, New Democratic Party, Bloc Québécois, Green Party, People’s Party. This market is specifically about the number of leaders who resign and not the number of parties that have leaders resign.
